title: Factorial experiment as a named grid
dek: Wikipedia factorial: all combinations of factor levels. Interaction geometry stays on stats-factorial.
story: A factorial experiment on Wikipedia is a grid: every combination of levels of two or more factors. The point is to estimate interactions rather than one-factor-at-a-time folklore.
stats-factorial already teaches the interaction contrast. This card is the encyclopedia grid, plus the warning that 'factorial ANOVA' in software is not the same as having designed the grid.
Fractional factorials alias interactions on purpose. If you did not plan the aliasing, you do not get to discover it in the discussion section.
deep: 2^k is the two-level celebrity. Mixed levels exist.
Blocking a replicate of a factorial is a DoE composition, not a new religion.
In TB labs: drug A × pH × inoculum as a grid is how you stop attributing pH to the drug.
GWAS is not a designed factorial of SNPs.

visual.caption: Two-by-two teaching grid: main effects versus a true interaction. Bars are schematic means, not data.
